name: Buzzshock
abilities: Bio-electrokinesis - stores and fires massive electrical discharges
Absorbs external electricity (drains a city block in seconds)
Self-electromorphosis: turns into living electricity and travels through wires/pipes
Possesses and controls or fries electrical devices
weaknesses: Can be trapped in non-conductive containers (glass)
Energy can be drained (Conductoids); no charge means he falls asleep
Small size is a liability against big brawlers like Phil
summary: A hyperactive living battery: a small black Nosedeenian who zaps, absorbs, rides power lines as pure electricity and multiplies when charged.
traits: Same species as the Megawhatts from Tourist Trap
Vitality tracks his charge - hyper when full, sleepy when empty
OV design has a battery cap on his head with the Omnitrix on it
notableFeats: Recharged a Null Void Projector to send Phil back to the Null Void (Max's Monster)
Battled Liam and Suemungousaur (The Color of Monkey)

appearances.designNotes: Black rounded battery body, green eyes, white lightning-bolt stripe front and back, +/- symbols on the back, hole on the head that vents electricity, Omnitrix on the chest.
Two bolts on each arm, lightning stripe recolored green, proper light-green battery cap on the head with the Omnitrix on top, more prominent chin, almond-shaped eyes.

scoring.rationale: Strong electrical offense and near-omni-mobility as living current through any wire, plus tech possession and duplication; but small, easily insulated or bottled, and switched off when drained.

notes: OS use is by Ben 10,000 only (present-day Ben's first use is OV's Max's Monster). Not used in AF/UA (UA intro only).
Also used by Ken (Ken 10) and Bad Ben (And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.
Editorial score calibration (principal pass): mobility 8→6, special 7→6, energy 8→7, regeneration 6→4 — to keep the roster ladder consistent across research batches.
